meta.title: Search by photo
meta.description: Upload, drop, paste or capture a photo of clothing and find visually similar products.

dialog.title: Search by photo
dialog.description: Show us something you like and we'll find similar pieces.

camera.failed: We couldn't start the camera. You can upload a photo instead.
